title: Proof of Block Decomposition
body_html:
Proof of Block Decomposition

  1. Decompose the algebra \(F^0[\Gamma]\) into field factors \(F_j\).
  2. Group the factors by the negative valuations of the components \(\Gamma_j\); collect nonnegative and zero components into block \(0\).
  3. Use the idempotents of the product algebra to define \(V_l\), \(\Gamma_l\), and the orthogonal direct-sum decomposition of \(V\).
  4. The idempotents lie in \(F^0[\Gamma]\), so the centralizer decomposes as a product of the block centralizers.
  5. The building point, character, and finite quotient representation decompose along this product.
  6. Each positive-depth block has one valuation and hence is single block; block \(0\) is depth zero.
